#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

long long modpow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) res = (res * a) % MOD;
        a = (a * a) % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long inv(long long a) {
    return modpow(a, MOD - 2);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int N;
    long long pk;
    cin >> N >> pk;

    if (pk > N - 1) {
        cout << 0 << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    int k = (int)pk;
    vector<long long> fact(N + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
        fact[i] = (i * fact[i - 1]) % MOD;
    }

    auto choose = [&](int a, int b) -> long long {
        if (b < 0 || b > a) return 0;
        long long num = fact[a];
        long long den = (fact[b] * fact[a - b]) % MOD;
        return (num * inv(den)) % MOD;
    };

    long long ans = 0;
    int sign = 1;
    int c = N - k;
    for (int i = 0; i <= c; ++i) {
        long long term = (choose(c, i) * modpow(i, N)) % MOD;
        term = (sign * term) % MOD;
        ans = (ans + term + MOD) % MOD;
        sign = -sign;
    }
    ans = (ans * choose(N, c)) % MOD;
    if (k > 0) {
        ans = (2 * ans) % MOD;
    }
    cout << ans << '\n';

    return 0;
}
